records.title: RASET: Router-Agnostic Safety-Critical Expert Tuning Exposes Localized Safety Enforcement Failures in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
records.reason: RASET identifies safety-critical MoE experts by contrastive harmful/benign activation and fine-tunes selected expert parameters while freezing router and other weights. Five open-weight MoE models show safety bypass with preserved general utility; this is a red-team/safety finding, not an efficiency improvement.

records.title: CP-MoE: Consistency-Preserving Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Learning
records.reason: CP-MoE adds consistency-preserving constraints to expert learning for continual-learning tasks and evaluates task performance/forgetting. It is an adaptation/training method, without inference throughput, memory, or latency evidence.
